title: Stolk et al. 2018 FieldTrip iEEG protocol dataset (SubjectUCI29): authors' preprocessed ECoG+SEEG epochs
description: A BIDS-packaged derivative of the preprocessed intracranial EEG (ECoG and SEEG) released with the FieldTrip human intracranial analysis protocol by Stolk et al. (2018). It contains 26 epochs of 152 channels sampled at 5000 Hz from one patient with medication-refractory epilepsy performing an auditory target-detection task, aligned to tone onset. Raw recordings were not shared by the authors. Electrode coordinates in several spaces and the authors' non-imaging source files are included.
methods_description: One adult epilepsy patient with 56 SEEG contacts on 7 depth leads and 96 ECoG contacts on two grids pressed a button on hearing a target tone. Trials were cut from -0.4 to 0.9 s around tone onset, demeaned, low-pass filtered at 200 Hz, and band-stop filtered around 60, 120 and 180 Hz using FieldTrip. Epochs were stored back to back in a BrainVision float32 file.
